items.action: None. A subclass that declares its own `unslotted` no longer collides with ours.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent or DrawerComponent. Template users need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.verify: The app builds, and no subclass of ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent or DrawerComponent reads `this.unslotted`.
items.note: ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent and DrawerComponent each lost the private `unslotted`.

items.action:
Delete the `dsTooltipClippedLead` binding. A `ds-table` header with a `hint` needs nothing in its place. Where it carried other text, write it into the tooltip string as `'**' + lead + '**
' + tip`. A subclass of TooltipDirective that declared `dsTooltipClippedLead` has nothing to rename any more.
items.appliesWhen: Only an element that binds `dsTooltipClippedLead`, and a class that extends TooltipDirective. `dsTooltip`, `dsTooltipWhenClipped` and `dsTooltipTextSelector` are unchanged.
items.pitfall: Deleting the binding drops the lead line; a tooltip never adds the host's text by itself, only a `dsDefinitionTerm` does.
items.verify: No template or class binds `dsTooltipClippedLead`, the app compiles, and a tooltip that used it shows its lead line, written into the string.

items.action: None, unless a tooltip string holds `**` meant literally: write `\*\*` there.
items.appliesWhen: Every `dsTooltip` string, including one a component builds from data. `dsTooltipWhenClipped` with no `dsTooltip` shows the host's text as written and is unaffected.
items.pitfall: A string with two `**` loses both and the text between them turns bold, with no error; user-supplied text reaching a tooltip needs its `**` escaped.
items.verify: Every tooltip string whose text contains `**` shows the asterisks, or bold where bold was meant.

items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename a member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends TooltipDirective or TooltipPanelComponent. Template users of dsTooltip need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: A redeclared private member collides as a public one does, and override cannot resolve it; only a rename does.
items.verify: The app builds with no member-collision error against TooltipDirective or TooltipPanelComponent.
items.note: TooltipPanelComponent gained 2: the protected segments and the public arrow. TooltipDirective gained 13: contains, document, dsTooltipArrow, dsTooltipPinOnClick, hostPinOnClick, leadsWithOwnText, onClick, onPointerLeave, ownText, pin, pinsOnClick, pointArrowAtHost and unpin; it lost dsTooltipClippedLead.

items.action: None, unless a stylesheet of yours reaches the "no matches" row of a picker panel through `.t-s`: select `.ds-dropdown-panel .empty` instead.
items.appliesWhen: Only a rule of yours whose selector combines the picker panel or its `.empty` row with `.t-s`. Ships in `styles/dropdown-overlay`, which `styles/ds` forwards. Other elements carrying `.t-s` are not affected.
items.pitfall: A selector such as `.ds-dropdown-panel .empty.t-s` still parses and matches nothing, so the override stops applying with no error.
items.verify: The built CSS holds no selector combining `.empty` with `.t-s`, and the "no matches" row of an open `ds-select` with no options shows your override.

informational.text: A `<div actions>` (or `<div drawer-footer>`) wrapper in the footer of `ds-modal`, `ds-modal-card`, `ds-drawer` and `ds-bottom-sheet` gets `display: contents` at zero specificity, so its buttons take the footer's gap, alignment and `ds-modal-card` stacking. A `display` set on the wrapper in your own styles still wins.
informational.verify: Open a dialog, drawer or bottom sheet whose buttons sit in a `<div actions>` and confirm they are spaced like buttons that carry `actions` themselves, not touching.

informational: `ds-modal`, `ds-modal-card` and `ds-drawer` no longer warn in dev mode about content without a slot, or about an attribute that names no slot. That content still renders in the body. A test or screenshot that waited for the `Dev warning` toast these raised has nothing to wait for.

informational.text: dsDefinitionTerm loads its own .ds-definition-term styles when the first term renders, so an app that assembles the style partials one by one instead of using styles/ds needs nothing.
informational.verify: in an app that does not import styles/ds, open a ds-table with a hinted column and confirm the header label has a dotted underline and turns accent with a 2px underline after a click.

informational.text: A ds-table header label with a hint is a button[dsDefinitionTerm]: a plain label pins its hint on click and takes the term's hover, pressed and pinned states; a sortable one sorts on click and pins nothing.
informational.verify: click a plain hinted ds-table header label, move the pointer away and confirm the hint stays open and the label shows the pinned accent until a click outside; click a sortable hinted label and confirm it sorts and no hint stays open.

informational.text: A tooltip's arrow points at the centre of its trigger when the panel is pushed off a viewport edge.
informational.verify: open a tooltip on a trigger near the left and the right viewport edge and confirm the arrow sits under the trigger's centre.

informational.text: Text that truncates or clips keeps its ascenders and descenders under any font: `ds-breadcrumbs`, the `ds-stat` label and value, every label ending in an ellipsis (`ds-select`, `ds-multi-select`, `ds-autocomplete`, `ds-sidenav-item`, `ds-sidenav-footer`, `ds-tree`, `ds-banner`, `ds-table` headers and cells), fit-mode chips, the `ds-date-picker` value, the `ds-filter-bar` row and resizable `ds-table` headers clip along the inline axis only. Their boxes keep their size.
informational.verify: set `--font-sans` to a font taller than its line box (a script or display face) and confirm the tails of g, j, p, q and y show whole in breadcrumbs, select values, table cells and a stat value, and that no row changed height.

informational.text: `text-clip.single-line-ellipsis` from `styles/text-clip` now clips the inline axis only; ink above and below the box paints over its neighbours as in any unclipped box. `text-clip.inline-axis` and `text-clip.line-clamp($lines)` are new in the same partial.
informational.verify: where a rule of yours includes `text-clip.single-line-ellipsis` in a box shorter than its text, confirm no glyph now paints over a neighbour.

informational.text: A `ds-stat` value clamped with `--ds-stat-value-lines` uses `line-height: normal`, so its tile is taller: two lines at the default size grow the tile from 147 to 165px in Mulish. In a browser without container style queries an unclamped value takes `line-height: normal` too.
informational.verify: open a stat that sets `--ds-stat-value-lines` and confirm the value shows whole lines with no accent of the next line peeking under the last, and that the tile's height fits its card.

informational: dsTooltipPinOnClick opens a tooltip on hover and focus with no delay and keeps it open after a click until a click outside, Escape or blur; a second click closes it. Without it a click closes the tooltip as before. While pinned the host carries data-ds-tooltip-pinned, a styling hook for the pinned trigger. Every pinned trigger of the library shows --accent-strong ink with no fill, plus a 2px solid accent underline on a text trigger; hover thickens the line to 3px and a press adds the --surface-muted fill (an icon takes a --surface-muted circle on hover and a --border-default circle on press). @include pinned.cue(), pinned.cue-hover() and pinned.cue-pressed() from styles/pinned give a trigger of your own the same cue, its hover and its press.

ds-info-hint (InfoHintComponent) is a question-mark icon button (icon="info" draws an "i"): ariaLabel names it, text shows on hover and focus and stays open after a click. The icon darkens on hover, sits on a muted circle while pressed and turns --accent-strong while pinned.

dsDefinitionTerm (DefinitionTermDirective) marks a term on any element with a dotted underline in --text-tertiary and shows its definition on hover and focus, pinned on click; on a host other than button it adds tabindex="0", role="button" and Enter / Space; [pinOnClick]="false" turns the pin off. Hover makes the underline solid, a press tints the term with --surface-muted, and a pinned term turns --accent-strong with a 2px solid accent underline; no state changes its size.

informational.text: A tooltip (dsTooltip, ds-info-hint, dsDefinitionTerm, a hinted ds-table header) and a ds-menu-item submenu close on a scroll of the window or of any scroll container under them; a pinned tooltip unpins.
informational.verify: open a tooltip and pin another inside a scrolling panel of your app, scroll the panel and confirm both close instead of staying where they opened.

informational: `styles/skeleton-shimmer` emits nothing and `styles/ds` no longer forwards it; `ds-skeleton` stops its shimmer under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` from its own styles, so an app that assembles the partials itself gets the stop too (delete list: skeleton-shimmer-use).

informational.text: The "no matches" row of `ds-select`, `ds-multi-select` and `ds-autocomplete` takes its font family, weight and line height from `styles/dropdown-overlay` (the `--ds-typography-s-*` hooks) instead of the `.t-s` class, so it keeps its type in an app that does not load `styles/typography`.
informational.verify: Open a picker with a query that matches nothing and confirm the row is set in the app's sans face, not a serif.

informational.text: Every component sets `box-sizing: border-box` on its host and its own elements, the inherited font on its form controls, zero margins on its headings and the base focus ring on its own focusable elements. An app that does not load `styles/reset` or `styles/focus` sees fields such as `ds-input` at 38.8px instead of 40px tall and the library's focus ring where the browser's showed.
informational.verify: In an app without `styles/reset`, open a form and confirm a `ds-input` field is 38.8px tall; tab to a `ds-number-stepper` step button and confirm the ring is the library's, not the browser's.

informational.text: `ds-container` with `size="sm|md|lg"` and the responsive rail of `ds-app-layout` fall back to the library's breakpoints when `--bp-*` is not set, so they work without `bp.emit-vars`; a `--bp-*` of yours still wins. The dev-mode warning about a missing `--bp-lg` is gone.
informational.verify: Without `bp.emit-vars`, confirm a `ds-container size="md"` is 768px wide at most and the `ds-app-layout` rail turns into a drawer below 1024px.

deleteList.why: ds-info-hint renders the icon button, its accessible name and the pinned tooltip.
deleteList.replaceWith: <ds-info-hint ariaLabel="..." text="..." />; keep a hand-built button whose click does something besides showing the text

deleteList.why: dsDefinitionTerm carries the dotted underline, the focus ring, the keyboard access and the pinned tooltip.
deleteList.replaceWith: <span dsDefinitionTerm="...">; keep a dotted underline that marks something other than a term with a definition

deleteList.why: The partial emits nothing; `ds-skeleton` carries its own reduced-motion stop.
